ValidationRule.description: The field 'Pending Reason' is required when Follow-up Date is selected. The epic for reference #1008. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType_Name__c ="Global Service Case",RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations"), NOT(ISNULL( Follow_up_Date__c )), ISPICKVAL( NAS_Pending_Reason__c , "" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Pending Reason' is required when Follow-up Date is selected.
